sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An epiphytic bromeliad of humid tropical forests in southeastern Mexico and Guatemala. The flowering rosette is about 50–70 cm tall; the leaves reach 70–137 cm.

sections.title: Inflorescence
sections.text: The branched inflorescence bears dense spikes about 3 cm long, tinted red or violet. The leaves are long and edged with small spines.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented.
